Option A: focused pilot
Every region reports its readiness each Monday; the steering group reviews open risks on Wednesday, agrees the mitigation owners and publishes a one-page status that the hub managers can act on the same week, before the next shipment window closes.

Option B: broad rollout
Every region reports its readiness each Monday; the steering group reviews open risks on Wednesday, agrees the mitigation owners and publishes a one-page status that the hub managers can act on the same week, before the next shipment window closes.
